title: NOT SOFT AT ALL.
text: NOT SOFT AT ALL.. I usually read all of the reviews and it seemed many people found this to be comfortable. I bought this to be a cushion for a desk chair and I needed it soft to ease my lower back pain. it is NOT soft. The cushion is well made, tightly tufted but the interior material is HARD. It hasn't worsened by back pain, but it hasn't eased it either. Still looking for the ideal desk chair cushion that I can sit on for extended periods of time at my desk. Still haven't found it.  I'll use it in my sunporch on hard wood chairs, but not what I needed at this time.
